title: Theories of “Gender” in NLP Bias Research

bias_targets.methodology: A literature survey and meta-analysis of 176 NLP papers to evaluate how gender and gender bias are theorized and operationalized, categorizing the field's use of gender proxies (e.g., pronouns, names, word lists, word pairs) and bias measurement metrics (e.g., performance parity, word embedding associations, counterfactuals).
